GA_differences.prior_MAE: Best inner MAE anchor, ties within1e-12 by burden, score count, mask. Threshold=anchor pooled MAE + sample-SD of its three fold MAEs / sqrt(3). Among visited masks within threshold+1e-12, choose smallest burden, then pooled MAE, score count, numeric mask.
GA_differences.prior_R2: Anchor is minimum pooled MSE; anchor ties within1e-12 prefer burden, score count, numeric mask. Threshold=anchor MSE+sample SD of its three fold MSEs/sqrt(3). Among all visited masks at or below threshold+1e-12 choose burden, pooled MSE, score count, numeric mask, in that order.
GA_differences.new_MoCA: Smallest pooled inner MSE; within1e-12 choose fewest optional source features, then additional instruments, then numeric bitmask. No one-SE allowance. The selected record equals the accuracy anchor.

important: Prior GA requires10 core variables and uses heuristic one-SE parsimony; new GA requires only MoCA and uses accuracy-first selection. This is not a clean ablation of the core variables. Core-plus18 and MoCA-plus18 include APOE and CBC-derived NLR; they are not exclusively clinical-assessment models.
